# 2. svydesignオブジェクト作成準備

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出
year_totals <- df_org %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
df_org <- df_org %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),                # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022)) #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
df_org <- df_org %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# 元データのラベル適正化
library(labelled)

# 1. 元のhaven_labelledデータから変換
df_org <- df_org %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.labelled), labelled::to_factor))

# ================================================================================
# 3. surveydesignオブジェクトの作成
# ================================================================================
library(survey)
library(glmnet)

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成
svy_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,          # Primary Sampling Unit (クラスター)
  strata = ~v022,       # 層化変数
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_org,
  nest = TRUE           # 入れ子構造
)

# 孤立PSUの処理
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
print("Survey designオブジェクトが作成されました")

# Survey designオブジェクトを保存
saveRDS(svy_design,
        file.path(save_path, "svy_design_org.rds")
)

# 後で使うラベル一覧を取得
#' *******************************************************************************
#' @title create_new_label
#' @description 変数ラベルと値ラベルを組み合わせた新しいラベルデータフレームを作成
#' @param df データフレーム
#' @param var_name 変数名（文字列）
#' @return データフレーム(variable, val_label, all_label)
#' *******************************************************************************
create_new_label <- function(df, var_name){
  var_label <- ifelse(is.null(var_label(df[[var_name]])),
                      var_name,
                      var_label(df[[var_name]]))
  val_labels <- val_labels(df[[var_name]])
  if (length(unique(df[[var_name]])) >= 30) {
    # 連続変数の場合は変数ラベルのみ返す
    label_str <- var_label
    variable <- var_name
    var_label <- var_label
    val_label_vec <- NA_character_
    label_ref <- var_name
  } else if (length(unique(val_labels)) > 0) {
    # カテゴリ変数で、かつ値ラベルが存在する場合、変数ラベル＋値ラベルを返す
    label_str <- paste0(var_label, ":", unique(val_labels))
    variable <- rep(var_name, length(unique(val_labels)))
    var_label <- var_label
    val_label_vec <- unique(val_labels)
    label_ref <- paste0(var_name, unique(val_labels))
  } else {
    # カテゴリ変数で、値ラベルが存在しない場合、変数ラベルのみ返す
    label_str <- var_label
    variable <- var_name
    var_label <- var_label
    val_label_vec <- NA_character_
    label_ref <- var_name
  }
  return(data.frame(var0 = variable,
                    var_label = var_label,
                    val_label = val_label_vec,
                    all_label = label_str,
                    label_ref = label_ref, # svyglm()とリンクするためのキー列
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
# ---- 関数ここまで ------------------------------------------------------------


# すべての変数に対してラベルを作成
all_var_labels <- var_label(svy_design$variables)
label_df <- data.frame()
for (var in names(all_var_labels)) {
  temp <- create_new_label(svy_design$variables, var)
  label_df <- rbind(label_df, temp)
}


```


# 3. 記述統計の作成

```{r}
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)

# *******************************************************************************
# '@title グループ別記述統計量の取得関数
# '@param design_obj srvyr::as_survey_designオブジェクト
# '@param covariates 記述統計量を取得する変数のベクトル
# '@param grp_var グループ変数の文字列
# '@param dummy_vars ダミー変数のベクトル
# '@return gtsummaryオブジェクト
# *******************************************************************************
get_summary <- function(design_obj, covariates, grp_var, dummy_vars) {
  # ★ value引数用のリストを事前に作成
  value_list <- lapply(dummy_vars, function(x) "1")
  names(value_list) <- dummy_vars
    
  res <- design_obj %>%
    tbl_svysummary(
      by = grp_var,
      include = all_of(covariates),
      type = list(
        contains("capita_score_ok") ~ "continuous",
        all_of(dummy_vars) ~ "dichotomous" # ダミー変数は二値変数として扱う
      ),
      # ★ ダミー変数の場合は1のみを表示
      value = value_list,
      statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
      missing = "no"
    ) %>%
    add_p(
      test = list(
        all_continuous()  ~ "svy.t.test",
        all_categorical() ~ "svy.wald.test"
      )
    ) %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ .x |>
        mutate(
          across(
            starts_with("stat_2"),
            ~ if_else(
              is.na(p.value),  # ★ まずNAをチェック
              .,               # NAならそのまま
              case_when(
                p.value < 0.001 ~ paste0(., " ***"),
                p.value < 0.01  ~ paste0(., " **"),
                p.value < 0.05  ~ paste0(., " *"),
                TRUE ~ .
              )
            ),
            .names = "{.col}"          )
        )
    ) %>%
    modify_table_styling(
      columns = "p.value",
      hide    = TRUE
    ) %>%
    add_n() %>%
    bold_labels()

  return(res)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. 解析群変数と追加変数の設定
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

covariates <- c("nt_wm_ht", "ch_below_2p5", "dm_child_more_than3", "rc_edu_acceptable",
                "dm_sheeep_own", "rh_anc_pvskill", "dm_refrigerator", 
                "nt_wm_ovobese", "ph_wtr_far", "dm_hh_head_30plus", 
                "dm_city", "dm_sani_open_yes", "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional", 
                "dm_weath_index", "rh_prob_permit", "ms_afm_15", 
                "ph_wtr_trt_cloth", "ch_stool_safe_no", "dm_dvjustify_onereas")

food_vars <- c("nt_mdd", "nt_mmf","nt_grains", "nt_root", "nt_nuts", 
               "nt_meatfish", "nt_milk", "nt_dairy", "nt_eggs", "nt_vita", 
               "nt_frtveg", "nt_root", 
                names(df_org)[grep("_log1p$", 
                                              names(df_org))],
                names(df_org)[grep("_score_ok$", 
                                              names(df_org))]
               )

outcome_var <- c("nt_ch_stunt", "nt_ch_wast", "nt_ch_any_anem", "nt_ch_haz")

descriptive_stat_vars <- c(covariates, food_vars, outcome_var)

# ダミー変数リスト(テーブル表示の際に、0/1のうち片方のみを表示させるため)
dummy_vars <- c(
  "nt_wm_ht", 
  "ch_below_2p5",

   "dm_sheeep_own",

  "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional",           
  "rh_prob_permit",

  "ph_wtr_trt_cloth", 
  "ch_stool_safe_no", 
  "dm_dvjustify_onereas",
  "nt_mdd", 
  "nt_mmf",
  "nt_grains",

)

# stuntedでの集計用に、stunted変数を除いたダミー変数リストを作成
dummy_vars_no_stunted <- setdiff(dummy_vars, c("nt_ch_stunt"))

# 2. svydesignの更新
design_all <- svy_design

# subsetの前にラベルを保存
var_labels_list <- var_label(design_all$variables)

# サブセット作成
design_pre <- subset(design_all, analysis_grp %in% c("control_pre(<2009)", "treat_pre"))
design_pre$variables$analysis_grp <- droplevels(design_pre$variables$analysis_grp)

design_post <- subset(design_all, analysis_grp %in% c("control_post(>=2009)", "treat_post"))
design_post$variables$analysis_grp <- droplevels(design_post$variables$analysis_grp)

# サブセット後にラベルを復元
var_label(design_pre$variables) <- var_labels_list
var_label(design_post$variables) <- var_labels_list

# 3. tbl_svysummaryで記述統計表を作成

result1 <- get_summary(design_pre, descriptive_stat_vars, "analysis_grp", dummy_vars)
result2 <- get_summary(design_all, descriptive_stat_vars, "nt_ch_stunt",
                       dummy_vars_no_stunted)

## tableの結合
final_table <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(result1, result2),
  tab_spanner = c("**By Intervention**", "**By Stunting Status**") # 大見出し
)

# 結果保存
saveRDS(result1, file.path(save_path, "descriptive_stat_pre.rds"))
saveRDS(result2, file.path(save_path, "descriptive_stat_by_stunted.rds"))

result2 %>% as_gt() %>% gtsave(file.path(save_path, "descriptive_stat_by_stunted.png"))
final_table %>% as_gt() %>% gtsave(file.path(save_path, "descriptive_stat_final.png"))
```
